REF-BM-08: selecting a list item links to the internal detail page (/bookmarks/:id), not the original url; the original is only reachable via a secondary 'Open page' link on the detail page. REF-BM-12: full-text search covers title, url, note, and tags but not description (field absent). REF-BM-15: implicit AND, OR, and NOT operators work and operators can be quoted as literals, but parenthesised groups are explicitly rejected (parser throws 'Grouping with parentheses is not supported yet'). REF-BM-20: no multi-select or bulk actions; actions are per-bookmark only. REF-BM-21: no bulk-apply-to-filtered-collection capability. REF-BM-24: no page snapshot (HTML) or PDF download/storage. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no saved bundle/filter entity or endpoint. REF-BM-30: no Netscape HTML import. REF-BM-31: no Netscape HTML export. REF-BM-32: no user-settings entity, endpoint, or UI; sort is transient session state only (no persisted default sort, items-per-page, or font size)."
}
